newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans firmer in moderate volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans firmer in moderate volume.

text.p: Argentine May soybeans were firmer at midsession Wednesday in cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices belatedly following Chicago's rise of the previous day, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for May soybeans gained $2 to $250 in moderate volume trade. April sunflower seed slid $5 to $197 in moderate turnover, with prices undermined by slack demand for oil. April wheat had lost $1 to $138 midsession in good volume, but traders said prices looked set to fight back later in the day. April maize was steady at $100 in good volume.
